scope: Bounded streaming of complete paged checkpoint packs from an immutable version-index generation

runtime_configuration.route: storage-only PagedReadHandle snapshot and file-backed durable base pack; no service route activated
runtime_configuration.target: immutable version-index generation with captured checkpoint LSN supplied by the snapshot owner
runtime_configuration.pack_output: sorted exact page images; coalesced buffer is four pages (16 KiB), uncoalesced buffer is one page (4 KiB)
runtime_configuration.memory_reservation: CheckpointValidation progress reservation is 6 pages for coalesced output or 3 pages for uncoalesced output; page loader separately charges decoded pages
runtime_configuration.publication: pack is synced and validated in tests, but index-root and manifest publication/WAL boundary rotation are not integrated

checks.name: paged_streamed_pack_focused_fixture
checks.summary: 1 passed; complete coalesced and uncoalesced pack output decodes and matches exact page images; two-page loader source reads increase; a pinned old reader is packed after a newer writer commit; injected page-write failure leaves an incomplete pack without publishing a manifest

checks.name: paged_streamed_pack_strict_clippy_tests
checks.summary: 32 existing crate lint findings; no diagnostic points to the new streamed pack writer or version-index descriptor traversal; no suppressions added

checks.name: paged_incremental_pack_output_focused
checks.summary: 1 passed; after a newer two-key commit, incremental pack output contains only pages newer than the previous checkpoint, is not marked complete, and every emitted image matches its target descriptor

checks.name: paged_incremental_index_focused
checks.summary: 1 passed; changed page locator moves to the incremental pack, unchanged page locator and both version tokens are preserved, and the resulting root validates as durable

checks.name: paged_incremental_strict_clippy
checks.summary: 32 existing crate findings; no diagnostic points to the incremental pack request, writer, or index application; no suppressions added

acceptance_mapping.stream_exact_target_generation_images: partial: VersionIndex::visit_descriptors streams sorted descriptors with bounded traversal state; exact captured generation pack is verified against every source page image after a newer writer commit
acceptance_mapping.incremental_and_complete_checkpoints: partial: complete pack output is verified; incremental output and index-root replacement are verified independently, but they are not integrated with durable manifest publication or WAL boundary rotation
acceptance_mapping.coalesced_and_uncoalesced_output: passed: both modes produce complete packs with matching page counts and exact images
acceptance_mapping.forced_cache_misses_larger_than_cache: passed for the fixture: eight indexed pages stream through a two-page decoded cache and source-read count increases
acceptance_mapping.writes_after_target_capture: passed: the old reader generation is packed after a newer multi-key writer commit and all target bytes match the captured pages
acceptance_mapping.checkpoint_failure_and_old_reader_retent: partial: complete pack failure and pinned old-reader output are verified; incremental index application under the eight-page fixture resource overlap exceeded the configured version-index resource capacity, and crash/reopen integration remains incomplete
acceptance_mapping.complete_reopen_oracle: not implemented for streamed incremental or complete checkpoint publication; existing T04 manifest/index reopen coverage remains separate
acceptance_mapping.bounded_memory_and_source_index_disk_res: partial: fixed output buffer and progress-pool reservation are bounded; source/index disk capacity reservation and publication overlap are not implemented
acceptance_mapping.checkpoint_debt_and_time_above_threshold: not implemented; no maintenance scheduler or tenant debt accounting exists yet

ownership_peaks.decoded_page_cache_limit_bytes: two pages in the focused fixture; the eight-page dataset is four times the configured decoded cache
ownership_peaks.unaccounted_boundaries: manifest/index publication, durable source overlap, filesystem cache, runtime stacks

failed_attempts.name: paged_streamed_pack_initial_progress_buffer_exceeded
failed_attempts.reason: initial 65-page reservation exceeded the fixture 64 KiB progress pool; output buffer was reduced to four pages and reservation to six pages

failed_attempts.name: paged_streamed_pack_extra_snapshot_exceeded_root_limit
failed_attempts.reason: holding a second snapshot exceeded the fixture root pin limit during writer publication; reused the existing pinned old-reader generation as the checkpoint target

failed_attempts.name: paged_streamed_pack_initial_strict_clippy_dead_code
failed_attempts.reason: new private checkpoint writer API triggered dead_code; exposed the storage API/output type and reran strict Clippy, leaving only the existing 32 crate findings

failed_attempts.name: paged_incremental_full_fixture_index_promotion_capacity
failed_attempts.reason: applying the incremental pack to the eight-page writer fixture while its old snapshot and base handles remained pinned exceeded the configured version-index resource capacity; the attempt is preserved and the missing overlap behavior remains an acceptance gap

failed_attempts.name: paged_incremental_strict_clippy_argument_count
failed_attempts.reason: strict Clippy found two new too-many-arguments diagnostics; the API now uses PagedCheckpointPackRequest and the final run reports only the 32 existing findings

failed_attempts.name: paged_incremental_clippy_missing_feature_gated_pathbuf_import
failed_attempts.reason: default Clippy compilation found the feature-only PathBuf import unused; the request now uses a fully qualified PathBuf type and final default and feature checks pass without warnings

remaining_work: Integrate complete and incremental streamed packs with durable checkpoint index construction, source registration, and PagedManifest publication
Capture the checkpoint root and rotate/sync a new WAL boundary atomically before manifest publication; retain prior roots until durable publication and retire sources only after pins release
Add failure/reopen oracles across pack, durable index, manifest pointer, and WAL boundary publication
Reserve source/index disk capacity and index-build memory; resolve the incremental root promotion overload under realistic pinned-root overlap
Test tiny-capacity bounded defer and progress after capacity release, including no partial manifest
Implement one-worker checkpoint continuation, bounded debt, and time-above-threshold accounting
